title: 现在的事
goal: 一般现在时、现在进行时、there be、疑问句与否定句

steps.title: 周末的习惯
lines: A
What do you usually do on weekends?
你周末一般做什么？
B
I often go shopping with my mother.
我常和妈妈去购物。
B
My brother never gets up before ten!
我弟弟从来不在十点前起床！
A
The shops open at nine, right?
商店九点开门，对吧？
steps.note: usually、often、never，还有 gets、open —— 说“经常、习惯、事实”用一般现在时。

steps.title: 一般现在时用来说什么
what: ① 习惯、经常做的事：I walk to work. She often goes shopping.
② 客观事实、真理：Water boils at 100°C. The sun rises in the east.
③ 时刻表、日程（即使是将来）：The train leaves at 8 tomorrow. The class starts at nine.
主语是三单时动词加 -s（上一单元讲过）：she works, it opens, he has。
why: 一般现在时说的不是“现在这一刻”，而是“一直如此、反复发生”的事。所以它常和 always, usually, often, every day 一起出现。
zh: 中文“我走路上班”“火车八点开”没有时态标记；英语要选时态。时刻表这一点最反直觉：说明天的火车也用现在时 —— 因为时刻表是固定的事实。
“现在这一刻正在做”不用一般现在时，用进行时（第 3 课）。
ex: I walk to work every day.
She usually takes a shower at night.
err: The train will leave at 7:30.（时刻表）
时刻表用一般现在时更自然
steps.sum: 习惯、事实、时刻表 → 一般现在时。

a: I walk to work every day.
I go to work on foot every day.
Every day I walk to work.

steps.title: 频率副词放哪里：实义动词前、be 动词后
what: always 总是 > usually 通常 > often 经常 > sometimes 有时 > rarely 很少 > never 从不
放在实义动词前：She often eats out.
放在 be 动词后：He is always late.
有助动词时放在助动词后：I can never remember his name.
why: 频率副词修饰的是动作本身，所以贴着动词；be 动词没有“动作”，频率副词就放在它后面，紧挨着表语。
zh: 中文“他总是迟到”“总是”在动词前；英语 be 动词句子要说 He is always late，不说 <s>He always is late</s>。
ex: I usually get up at seven.
He is never at home on Sundays.
We sometimes go out for dinner.

drill.q: 频率副词的位置正确的是？

x: I take a shower every night.

steps.text: What do you usually do on weekends?
steps.focus: USUALLY 和 WEEKENDS 重读，do you 连读

steps.a: I take a shower every night.
I take a shower every night.

points: 重点：一般现在时说习惯、事实、时刻表；三单加 -s。
重点：频率副词放实义动词前、be 动词后：I often go，he is always late。
on weekends 周末；go shopping 购物；take a shower 洗澡。

steps.title: 你做什么工作？
lines: A
What do you do?
你是做什么的？
B
I work in an office. I don't like it much.
我在办公室上班，不太喜欢。
A
Does your wife work there too?
你妻子也在那儿工作吗？
B
No, she doesn't. She's a teacher.
不，她是老师。
steps.note: don't、does、doesn't：一般现在时的否定和疑问要“请”助动词 do 帮忙。

steps.title: 否定和疑问：借 do / does，动词回到原形
what: 否定：主语 + don't / doesn't + 动词原形：I don't eat meat. She doesn't like coffee.
疑问：Do / Does + 主语 + 动词原形？Does he work here? — Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't.
三单的 -s 已经“跑到” does 上了，后面的动词就不再加 s：She doesn't like（不是 likes）。
why: 英语否定和疑问需要一个“助动词”来承担 not 和语序变化。实义动词自己不能直接加 not（<s>I like not</s>），所以借 do。时态和人称由 do / does 来标，主动词退回原形。
zh: 中文否定加“不”、疑问加“吗”就行：“他不喜欢”“他喜欢吗”。英语要变结构：He doesn't like，Does he like…?
ex: Does he work here? — No, he doesn't.
steps.sum: do / does 一出现，主动词就回原形。

drill.q: — Does he work here? — No, he ___.

steps.title: be 动词的句子不用 do
what: 句子的谓语是 be（am / is / are）时，否定和疑问直接用 be：Are you tired? I'm not hungry.
谓语是实义动词时才用 do / does：Do you like it? I don't know.
why: be 本身就能当“助动词”用（可以直接加 not、可以提前），所以不需要 do 帮忙。
zh: 中国学生常把两套混在一起：<s>Do you tired?</s>（形容词前没有实义动词）、<s>Are you like music?</s>（like 是实义动词）。判断方法：句子里有没有实义动词。
ex: Are you hungry? — No, I'm not.
Do you like music? — Yes, I do.
She isn't at home. She doesn't feel well.
err: like 是实义动词，用 do
steps.sum: 有实义动词用 do，没有就用 be。

x: — Is it hard? — I don't think so.
What do you do? — I'm a nurse.
你做什么工作？——我是护士。

steps.text: Does your wife work there too? No, she doesn't.
steps.zh: 你妻子也在那儿工作吗？不。
steps.focus: 问句句末上扬，doesn't 重读

a: What do you do for a living?

points: 重点：否定 don't / doesn't + 原形；疑问 Do / Does + 主语 + 原形；简短回答 Yes, he does.
重点：be 动词句子不用 do：Are you tired? / Do you like it?
I don't think so. 我不这么认为；What do you do? 你做什么工作？

steps.title: 此刻在做什么
lines: A
What are you doing?
你在做什么？
B
I'm waiting for my friend. She's running late.
我在等朋友。她要迟到了。
A
Who are you talking to on the phone?
你在跟谁打电话？
B
My mom. She's cooking dinner at the moment.
我妈。她现在在做晚饭。
steps.note: am / is / are + -ing：说“此刻正在发生”的事。

steps.title: 现在进行时 vs 一般现在时
what: 现在进行时 am / is / are + -ing：此刻正在，或这段时间暂时如此 —— I'm reading now. I'm living with my parents this month.
一般现在时：经常、长期如此 —— I read every night. I live in Shanghai.
信号词：now, right now, at the moment, Look!, Listen! → 进行时；every day, usually, often → 一般现在时
why: 两种时态的区别是“临时”和“一贯”：I work in a bank（我的工作）/ I'm working in a bank this summer（这个暑假临时在银行干活）。
zh: 中文用“在”“正在”表示进行（我在看书），但也常常不标；英语必须二选一。最常见的错误是说此刻的事却用一般现在时：<s>Look! He runs.</s>
ex: It rains a lot here in June.
I'm staying at a hotel this week.
She usually walks, but today she's taking a taxi.
err: Listen! Someone knocks at the door.
Listen! Someone is knocking at the door.
I am go to work every day.
I go to work every day.
steps.sum: 此刻、临时 → 进行时；经常、长期 → 一般现在时。

drill.q: She usually ___ to work, but today she ___ a taxi.

drill.zh: 你在做什么？我在等我的朋友。
a: What are you doing? I'm waiting for my friend.
What are you doing? I am waiting for my friend.

steps.title: 状态动词一般不用进行时
what: 表示状态、感觉、想法、拥有的动词一般不用进行时：know, like, love, want, need, believe, understand, have（拥有）, belong
I know the answer.（不说 I'm knowing）　I want a coffee.（不说 I'm wanting）
why: 进行时表示“正在进行、有开始有结束的动作”。知道、喜欢、需要是一种状态，本身没有“进行中”的过程。
zh: 中文“我现在知道了”有“现在”，于是很多人说 <s>I'm knowing now</s>。
注意 have 表示“吃、喝、度过”时是动作，可以用进行时：I'm having lunch.（我在吃午饭）
ex: 我在和汤姆吃午饭。（have = 吃）
err: She is wanting a new phone.
steps.sum: know / like / want / need / believe：不用 -ing。

steps.focus: I'm 读得很轻，WAIT 重读

points: 进行时 am / is / are + -ing；-ing 变法：make → making，run → running。
重点：此刻、临时用进行时，经常、长期用一般现在时。
重点：know / like / want / need 等状态动词不用进行时。

steps.title: 附近有银行吗？
lines: A
Excuse me, is there a bank near here?
打扰一下，附近有银行吗？
B
Yes, there are two banks on this street.
有，这条街上有两家。
B
There's a café next to the first one.
第一家旁边有家咖啡馆。
steps.note: “某处有某物”英语用 there is / there are，不用 have。

steps.title: “某处有某物”：There be，不是 have
what: There is + 单数 / 不可数：There is a park near my house. There is some milk.
There are + 复数：There are two banks on this street.
have 表示“某人拥有”：I have a car. 不能用来说“某处有”。
why: There be 是“存在句”：先用 there 占住主语位置，把真正的新信息（有什么）放到后面。英语喜欢把新信息放在句尾。
zh: 中文“桌上有一本书”“这附近有银行”用“有”，很多人就直译成 <s>The desk has a book</s>、<s>Here has a bank</s>。英语里“地点 + 有”一律用 there be。
ex: There is a book on the table.
There are lots of people in the park.
Is there a station near here?
There isn't any milk in the fridge.
err: There is a book on the table.
Is there a bank near here?
steps.sum: 地点 + 有 → There is / There are；人拥有 → have。

o: Is there a station near here?

drill.q: There ___ a lot of people in the park.
There ___ some water in the bottle.

a: There is a book on the table.
There's a book on the table.
There is a book on the desk.
There's a book on the desk.

steps.title: There be 的就近原则、否定和疑问
what: be 和紧挨着的第一个名词一致：There is a pen and two books. / There are two books and a pen.
否定：There isn't / aren't + any：There aren't any chairs.
疑问：Is / Are there …? — Yes, there is. / No, there aren't.
why: 说到 is 的时候，说话人脑子里只有下一个名词，所以 be 跟着它走。
zh: 中国学生常按“总数”选 are：<s>There are a pen and two books.</s> 口语里母语者也会说 there's 加复数，但考试按就近原则。
ex: There is a pen and two books on the desk.
桌上有一支笔和两本书。
Are there any questions? — No, there aren't.
err: There are a pen and two books.
There is a pen and two books.

drill.q: There ___ a pen and two books on the desk.
There ___ (not be) any chairs in the room.

a: There are two banks on this street.
There are two banks in this street.
There are two banks on the street.

x: Is there a bank near here?
The café is next to the bank.

steps.text: Is there a bank near here?
steps.focus: Is there 连读，句末上扬

steps.a: The café is next to the bank.
Excuse me, is there a bank near here?

a: The café is next to the bank.
The cafe is next to the bank.

points: 重点：地点 + 有 → There is / are，不用 have。
重点：就近原则 There is a pen and two books；否定 there aren't any；疑问 Is there …?
near here 附近；next to 在旁边；on the left 在左边。

steps.title: 问一问
lines: A
What time do you get up?
你几点起床？
B
At six. How often do you go to the gym?
六点。你多久去一次健身房？
A
Twice a week. How long does it take to get there?
一周两次。去那儿要多久？
B
About twenty minutes.
大约二十分钟。
steps.note: what time、how often、how long：问句的“疑问词 + 一般疑问句语序”。

steps.title: 疑问词 + 一般疑问句语序
what: 特殊疑问句 = 疑问词 + 一般疑问句：
Where do you live?　What is she doing?　When does the class start?
问主语时例外，直接用陈述语序：Who called you?（不说 Who did call you?）　What happened?
why: 先把“是不是”问句造出来（Do you live…?），再把疑问词放到最前面替换掉要问的部分。问主语时疑问词本身就是主语，不需要再倒装。
zh: 中文疑问词放在原位：“你住哪儿？”英语要提到句首，还要倒装：Where do you live? 常见错误：Where you live?、What you are doing?
ex: What time does the train leave?
steps.sum: 疑问词 + do / be + 主语；问主语时直接说。

a: What time does the train leave?

steps.title: how 的组合：how many / much / long / often / far
what: how many + 可数复数：多少个　how much：多少（不可数）/ 多少钱
how long：多长时间　how often：多久一次（回答 every day, twice a week）
how far：多远　how old：几岁
why: how + 形容词 / 副词 = “多……”。问“多久一次”和“多长时间”是两回事：How often（频率）/ How long（时长）。
zh: 中文“多久”可以指频率也可以指时长（“多久去一次”“去多久”），英语要分开。
ex: How often do you play tennis? — Twice a week.
你多久打一次网球？——一周两次。
How long does it take to get there? — About twenty minutes.
去那儿要多久？——大约二十分钟。
err: How long do you play tennis?（问频率）
How often do you play tennis?
steps.sum: 频率 how often，时长 how long。

drill.q: ___ do you play tennis? — Twice a week.
___ long does it take to get there?
___ do you go to work? — By train.

x: How long does it take to get there?

steps.a: What time do you get up?
What time do you get up?

a: How often do you go to the gym?

steps.prompt: 写一段 4–5 句的英文自我介绍，说说你的日常：做什么工作、每天几点做什么、周末通常做什么、现在正在学什么。
steps.hint: 检查清单：三单 -s？频率副词位置？否定用 don't / doesn't？此刻的事用进行时？
steps.focus: present simple vs continuous, do/does, frequency adverbs, there be, questions
steps.model: I work in an office in Hangzhou. I usually get up at seven and take the subway to work. I don't work on weekends. On Saturdays I often go shopping with my wife. At the moment I'm learning English, and I study for an hour every day.

points: what / who / where / when / why / how / which / whose。
重点：疑问词 + do / be + 主语 + 动词；问主语直接说：Who called you?
重点：how often 频率，how long 时长，how far 距离，how many / much 数量。

steps.title: Waiting for Kate
steps.note: 先关掉译文读一遍，只用学过的词和本单元的重点。读不懂的句子点 ▶ 听一遍，再打开译文核对。
lines: It's Saturday morning. Maria doesn't go to the office on weekends.
星期六早上。玛丽亚周末不去办公室。
Right now, she is sitting in a café near her home.
此刻，她正坐在家附近的一家咖啡馆里。
There are a lot of people here, but there is a free table next to the window.
这里人很多，但窗边有一张空桌子。
She is waiting for her friend Kate.
她在等她的朋友凯特。
Maria and Kate usually go shopping together on Saturdays.
玛丽亚和凯特周六通常一起去购物。
But today Kate is late. "Where are you?" Maria asks in a message.
可今天凯特迟到了。“你在哪儿？”玛丽亚发消息问。
"I'm on the bus. There's a lot of traffic," Kate writes back.
“我在公交车上，路上很堵，”凯特回复。
While she waits, Maria reads a book and watches the people outside.
等的时候，玛丽亚一边看书，一边看窗外的行人。
A man is walking his dog, and two children are playing in the park across the street.
一个男人在遛狗，两个孩子在街对面的公园里玩。
How often does Maria come here? Almost every week. She loves this place.
玛丽亚多久来一次？几乎每周。她很喜欢这里。
Twenty minutes later, Kate runs in. "Sorry! What time is it?"
二十分钟后，凯特跑了进来。“对不起！几点了？”
"It's ten thirty. Let's go!"
“十点半了。走吧！”

o: in a café near her home

steps.q: What are the two children doing?
How often does Maria come to the café?

o: There has a free table next to the window.
There is a free table next to the window.
Have a free table next to the window.
steps.e: “某处有某物”用 There be，不用 have。

a: She is waiting for her friend.

points: 一般现在时说习惯：Maria doesn't go to the office on weekends. / They usually go shopping.
重点：现在进行时说此刻 —— She is sitting… / A man is walking his dog.
重点：There be —— There are a lot of people. / There is a free table（就近原则）。
How often …? / What time is it?

extra.q: Look! The kids ___ in the rain.
There ___ two cats under the table.
